prs.body:
Closes #1652

Repeated Saturday, Sunday, and holiday lookups previously refetched the same prior trading-day quote on every call. Track successfully fetched windows by normalized ticker and requested date so subsequent lookups reuse the available cached quote.

The first lookup still refreshes a partial cache. Different tickers and later dates refresh independently, and disabling the cache continues to fetch on each successful lookup. Failed, empty, or out-of-window provider responses do not mark a cached window checked, preserving retries after an unusable refresh. Checked dates live only for the adapter instance.

## Tasks and acceptance
- [x] Add checked-date caching to `PriceAdapter.close_on_or_before`.
- [x] Cover Saturday, Sunday, and holiday dates with initially empty and preloaded SQLite caches; repeated AAPL lookups make exactly one provider request.
- [x] Cover normalized tickers, different symbols, later trading dates, disabled caching, and retry after failed/empty/out-of-window refreshes.
- [x] `python -m pytest tests/test_adapter_base.py` passes: 26 passed.
- [x] Deliberately remove the checked-date guard and rerun the same gate: 9 failed, 17 passed on redundant request assertions. Restore the guard: 26 passed.

## Validation
- `python -m pytest tests/test_adapter_base.py tests/test_backtest_flow.py tests/test_attribution_flow.py`: 49 passed; seven existing FastAPI deprecation warnings.
- Expanded tests against the original implementation: 9 failed, 17 passed.
- `python -m ruff check adapters/prices.py tests/test_adapter_base.py`: passed.
- `python -m black --check --target-version py312 adapters/prices.py tests/test_adapter_base.py`: passed.
- `git diff --check`: passed.

Provider behavior is injected at the supported fetcher boundary; these are offline tests using real SQLite storage, with no live market-data calls. Local test transcripts: `/Users/teacher/.codex/automations/pd-workloop-resume/artifacts/20260913T2001Z/` (`fixed-tests.txt`, `deliberate-break.txt`, `restored-tests.txt`).
